svg.text: Layer behind: ANE1, same structure; separate power gating, NE clock
Task control: fetch TDs in order, write register values to each unit (Sec. 5.7)
Kernel DMA: weight reads, 16 groups, one per NE
8 ch. · 10656 MT/s · 170.5 GB/s peak; shared by both ANEs, weight reads total ≈ 150 GB/s
System-level cache (SLC): compiler parameter 16 MiB; weights bypass SLC on default path
